name: Item Forecast Report
query:
SELECT i.name AS item_code, i.item_name, 
       IFNULL(SUM(s.actual_qty), 0) AS past_consumption, 
       IFNULL(SUM(s.actual_qty), 0) * %(forecast_months)s AS forecast_qty, 
       IFNULL((SELECT pri.rate FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` pr ON pr.name = pri.parent WHERE pri.item_code = i.name ORDER BY pr.posting_date DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS last_purchase_rate, 
       IFNULL(SUM(s.actual_qty), 0) * %(forecast_months)s * IFNULL((SELECT pri.rate FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` pr ON pr.name = pri.parent WHERE pri.item_code = i.name ORDER BY pr.posting_date DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS estimated_fund 
FROM `tabItem` i 
LEFT JOIN `tabStock Ledger Entry` s ON s.item_code = i.name AND s.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s 
WHERE (COALESCE(%(item_group)s,'') = '' OR i.item_group = %(item_group)s)  
GROUP BY i.name, i.item_name 
ORDER BY i.item_name ASC
